coverage_notes: Paragraph P0009 states that the license terminates automatically upon breach or Agreement termination, permits Databricks to terminate it on notice, and requires permanent deletion of the Licensed Materials and all copies upon termination. The fixed activity vocabulary has no faithful activity for termination or deletion; no Use clause is inferred.

paragraph_audit.reason: The paragraph's operative termination events and Databricks termination power do not fit a permitted activity. Its express duty to permanently delete the Licensed Materials and all copies also has no faithful permitted activity; deletion is not modeled as Use.
